subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `/models test-fallback` diagnostic, fold fallback-chain probing into `models status --probe`, or defer it into the broader staged model-migration workflow?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but it adds live provider-call UX and overlaps two open model diagnostics/migration requests, so maintainers need to choose the permanent command contract before automation implements it.

options.title: Define a focused fallback-chain probe
options.body: Add a targeted command that begins at configured fallback candidates and reports first or all fallback results while keeping broader health checks separate.

options.title: Fold into broader model health checks
options.body: Make this a mode of the configured-model probe work so one CLI/status contract owns all live model validation output.

options.title: Defer to staged model migration
options.body: Leave this issue open only as a subproblem of the staged migrate/test/promote/rollback workflow.

recommendation.title: Define a focused fallback-chain probe
recommendation.body: Add a targeted command that begins at configured fallback candidates and reports first or all fallback results while keeping broader health checks separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and issue discussion show the strongest combination of model-status, fallback policy, and prior product-review context.
